caption: A magnifying glass is moved over a page of small print, and the letters under the lens appear much larger.

sa.check: A magnifying glass is moved over a page of print.
The letters under the lens appear larger.
The enlargement is strong: the letters look much larger.

pc.expect: Only the letters seen through the lens are enlarged, and they shift as the lens moves.
pc.fail: Letters outside the lens are enlarged; or the letters under the lens are the same size; or the enlarged patch stays put while the lens moves.

pc.expect: The page itself is unchanged; the enlarged letters are the same words, larger.
pc.fail: The letters under the lens are different words; or the page's print changes; or the enlarged letters are mirrored.

pc.expect: The page stays put and the image changes only as the lens moves.
pc.fail: The page slides; or the image shifts with the lens still; or letters move by themselves.
It bends; or ripples; or goes opaque.
The lens duplicates; or the page vanishes; or the hand passes through the lens.

pc.expect: The page and the lens frame stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper changes colour; or the frame changes; or the desk changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
